pll2d6c3-d1e3514.summary: States that demons may not dwell in heaven, being bright and pleasant, nor on earth with us lest they harm us too much, but in the dark air as a prison until judgment, per Peter's epistle; then they will be thrust into hell (Matt 25:41).
claims: The air is the demons' prison until judgment.

pl-l2d6c3.summary: Explains that the demons may not dwell in heaven, a bright and pleasant place, nor on earth with us, lest they harm men too much, but in the dark air, assigned them as a prison until judgment (1 Peter); then they will be cast into hell (Matt 25:41).
claims: Demons may not dwell in heaven or on earth.
The dark air is their prison until judgment.
At judgment they will be cast into hell.
